statement: The travel record for H-3 gives a clear travel limit of plus 15 millimetres, but I will not run this scan because the stage physically hits the detector housing at plus 8 mm—executing a scan to plus 15 would cause a collision. The travel record needs to be updated to reflect the actual safe limit before any scan can proceed.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the record's plus 15 mm limit contradicts the physical collision at plus 8 mm and refuses: "executing a scan to plus 15 would cause a collision."
